headline: Chilean iron ore miner Grupo CAP reports $128 million loss
summary: Chilean iron ore miner Grupo CAP reported a third-quarter loss of $71 million, bringing its total loss for the first nine months of 2026 to $127.8 million.
why: Grupo CAP is a major player in the Chilean mining and steel sector, and its performance is sensitive to global iron ore prices.

impacts.name: Grupo CAP
impacts.why: Significant financial losses typically negatively impact investor sentiment.
